news.headline: Sell high: Siakam, Norman Powell, Huerter and Saddiq Bey
news.take: Siakam and Powell are still useful starters, so only sell for clear value. Huerter and Bey are fine to move.
news.detail: Siakam’s usage should fall when Haliburton returns; Powell’s surge comes from injuries around him and hot two-point shooting; Huerter and Bey are riding unusual block and shooting numbers.

news.headline: Jalen Smith, Ace Bailey, Jeremiah Fears and Moussa Diabate are must-roster
news.take: If any is on waivers in this league, he’s worth a claim.
news.detail: All four have steady minutes and production that should last. Fears in particular is getting more usage with Dejounte Murray away from the team.

news.headline: Cade expected back Friday; Reaves still out; Nembhard questionable
news.take: Start Cade on Friday (that day locks Sat 21 Nov, 8:00 AM MYT). Keep Reaves on IR.
news.detail: Cunningham (knee) is expected to play Friday against Toronto. Reaves (heel) is out again Friday against Sacramento with no return date. Nembhard (hip) is questionable Friday at Cleveland.

news.headline: Deni Avdija (foot) sat out Thursday
news.take: Check his status before Saturday's games lock (Sun 22 Nov, 2:00 AM MYT).
news.detail: Avdija missed Thursday's game against Milwaukee with a foot problem, his second straight absence. Portland plays again Saturday.

news.headline: Milwaukee and Indiana rotations are unpredictable
news.take: Our data agrees: Herro and Jaquez are down to about 23 minutes over the last week. Hold, but don't add more Bucks.
news.detail: Josh Lloyd warns against chasing hot shooting nights from Bucks and Pacers players: their minutes depend on absences and odd coaching decisions.

news.headline: Jaren Jackson Jr. has a torn MCL, out 6–8 weeks
news.take: IR stash only. Don't count on him before the new year.
news.detail: He tore the MCL in his right knee in late October. The expected return is mid-December at the earliest.

news.headline: Anthony Edwards has 'no clue' when he'll return from knee surgery
news.take: Keep him on IR. Insurance Agent should plan as if he's out for weeks.
news.detail: Edwards says he's optimistic about the long term but has no timeline after knee surgery a few weeks ago.

news.headline: Zubac is a hold, not a drop; sell Embiid for a top-25 player if you can
news.take: Fair on both. Zubac is a patience play; Embiid's injury history makes selling sensible.
news.detail: Zubac has fallen outside the top 150 but his role should recover. Embiid's shooting hasn't been elite; a top-25 return would be a win, though unlikely right now.
